stresses: a 3-week gap: re-entry briefing; structure held; timers paused
description: The incident is resolved through the fleet fix (F35), then the scientist disappears for three weeks. On return, the durability-and-retrospective batch (F29/F30/F37/F38/F40) lands. Re-entry must be a consequence-ranked briefing, the record must be structurally exactly as left with Class-2 timers paused, and the F38 load test must absorb cleanly even though scenario time has moved weeks past the incident.

assertions.expect: re-entry after 21 days opens with a briefing: authored, past-tense, ranked by consequence (fix holding, clean peaks, open durability questions lead), scaled to time away - not an activity diff or unread-item dump
Class-2 proposals pending at departure did not expire during the gap - their timers paused - and the held stack is finite, decided in the tray on return; nothing above Class 1 was applied while away
the record's structure is exactly as left: no promotion, demotion, split, or archive happened during the absence; numbers and sediment stayed current (fast clock) while structure froze (slow clock)

the durability planned item registered before the gap (plan gesture on F35) is still present and is taken up by this sitting; the retrospective work resumes from the plan rather than from re-derived context
the work record shows the 21-day gap honestly, and the post-gap sitting carries a chain edge to the pre-gap episode
the Q3 detection post-mortem earns its section from the post-gap batch on its own evidence; nothing pretends the section existed during the gap
